name: blast-radius
description: Holds risky Bash commands, secret file access, and rm/mv or file-tool writes outside the project, showing secrets, repos, uncommitted work and file dates before they run. Fork of hamzafer/claude-code-mods.

trustedFolders.title: Trusted folders (writes)
trustedFolders.description: Comma-separated folders. Writes there run without a hold; deletes and secret files are still held.

timeoutSeconds.title: Auto-cancel after (seconds)
timeoutSeconds.description: How long a held command waits for Cancel or Proceed before it is cancelled. 0 waits forever.
